sources.snippet: Who is MergeKit for? MergeKit is built for ML researchers who want to publish reproducible merge experiments, independent developers who need capable open models without fine-tuning budgets, and AI teams who want to track the community's best merged models from a single dashboard.

sources.snippet: MergeKit, a tools for merging pretrained LLM and create Mixture of Experts (MoE) from open-source models. Mergekit uses an out-of-core approach to perform unreasonably elaborate merges in resource-constrained situations.
